in_marathi.name: Devdutt
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devdutt हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devdutt is a compound name derived from Sanskrit. 'Dev' meaning 'god' and 'dutt' meaning 'servant' or 'son of god'. This name is given to a boy to signify that he is a god in his own right and a servant or son of the supreme god.
